title: Plan
description: Simple server sided mod that allows players to teleport to a creative dimension where they can design builds and collaborate with invited players all from within the same server.
body:
# Plan

**Private creative build worlds for every player — right on your survival server.**

Plan gives each player their own private, creative "plan" dimensions to design and build in, then
step back into survival exactly as they left it. Builds happen in isolated **projects** you can keep,
name, share with friends, and throw away — without ever touching your main world.

Server-side only, for **NeoForge**. Players connect with a normal vanilla client; nothing to
install client-side. (But many mods are supported)

---

## How it works

- A **project** is a private build area — its own region with its own nether and end (reached by
  building portals), generated on its own scrambled seed so it never reveals your real world.
- **Entering** a project drops you into creative mode with a fresh inventory that belongs to that
  project. **Leaving** puts back your real gamemode, inventory (every slot, including modded ones),
  ender chest, position and momentum — exactly as before.
- Each project keeps its **own inventory per player**, so switching projects never mixes your stuff.
- Projects can be **shared**: invite a friend and they can join any time.

Everything you do inside a project stays inside it. While in a plan dimension you can't earn
advancements, your statistics don't change, FTB Quests can't complete, and the world border is always
full-size so you're never stuck out of bounds.

---

## Getting started

1. `/plan create regular` — makes your main "regular" project and drops you into it in creative.
2. Build. Use `/plan fill`, `/plan time`, `/plan weather`, etc. as you like.
3. `/plan leave` — back to survival, right where you were, with your real inventory.
4. `/plan join regular` — hop back into your build any time.

Make more with `/plan create regular My Castle` (or `superflat` for a flat canvas). Invite a friend
with `/plan invite <player>` and they'll get a clickable message to join.

---

## Commands

**Projects**
- `/plan create <superflat|regular> [name]` — Create a new project and enter it. Name is optional
  (defaults to your main, then `Blueprint 1`, `Blueprint 2`, …).
- `/plan join <superflat|regular>` — Enter your main project of that type.
- `/plan join <name>` — Enter one of your own projects by name. Others' shared projects show as
  `Owner's Name` (all names tab-complete).
- `/plan leave` — Leave the project and restore your real state.
- `/plan list` — List every project you can access.
- `/plan relocate [name]` — Move a project to a fresh area (the current one if no name is given).
- `/plan delete <name>` — Delete a project you own and revert its plot.

**Sharing**
- `/plan invite <player>` — Give a player permanent access to your current project.
- `/plan revoke <player>` — Remove a player's access (owner only).

**Building (only inside a plan dimension, no operator status needed)**
- `/plan fill <from> <to> <block> [mode]` — Fill within your plot. Coordinates and blocks
  tab-complete; modes are replace/destroy/keep/hollow/outline.
- `/plan locate structure|biome|poi <id>` — Locate within your plan dimension (tab-completes the list).
- `/plan clear` — Empty your own inventory.
- `/plan gamemode <survival|creative|adventure|spectator>` — Change your own gamemode.
- `/plan time <day|noon|night|midnight|ticks>` — Set the time in your plan dimension.
- `/plan weather <clear|rain|thunder>` — Set the weather in your plan dimension.
